verdict.rationale: The only capture-related evidence is the in-app Bookmarks feature, where Anytype fetches a URL's title, description, preview image and favicon and stores them as Properties on an Object. That is a thin URL-capture flow, not a browser clipper. The local API could let one be built, but nothing shows an official clipper exists. Missing for 10: an official browser extension or clipper, full article/page content capture, highlight clipping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
